articleSections.headline: Unlocking the Digestive Power of Cranberry Juice
articleSections.content:

This vibrant, antioxidant-rich drink is more than just a tasty beverage—it may play a role in supporting your digestive health and keeping your gut happy.

articleSections.headline: How Cranberry Juice Supports Digestion
articleSections.content:
Cranberry juice is packed with antioxidants and contains natural fiber, which can help maintain a balanced gut environment. For some people, it may even have a gentle, mild laxative effect, supporting regular bowel movements.

articleSections.content:

Gut Balance: Encourages the growth of beneficial bacteria.

Anti-Inflammatory Boost: Antioxidants help reduce inflammation in the digestive system.

articleSections.headline: How to Enjoy Cranberry Juice for Digestive Health
articleSections.content:
Make cranberry juice work for you with these simple tips:

Eat Fiber-Rich Foods: Fruits, vegetables, and whole grains enhance effectiveness.

Track With AI‑MD: Monitor your digestive responses and adjust intake accordingly.

Moderation is Key: Enjoy cranberry juice as part of a balanced diet rather than relying on it alone.

articleSections.headline: Safety and Things to Consider
articleSections.content:

Everyone Reacts Differently: Digestive responses vary from person to person.
